bootstrap_click_text: the Acme EDA command line, the text entry line at the bottom of the command window
briefing:
Execute these steps in order (the worked plan for this task):
1. observe — read the remote desktop inside the VNC viewer.
2. mouse_agent click, text: 'the Acme EDA command line' — the one-line text entry along the bottom edge of the command window, below its log text area. (The executor may already have clicked it as a bootstrap; click again if focus is elsewhere.) SESSION MAP: the remote desktop holds the command window, one or more document editor windows, and a Terminal. The Terminal is a plain shell, NOT part of the EDA app: NEVER type app commands into it. If the command window is covered, click its title bar to raise it first.
3. kbd_agent type_verify: openCellView("acme_lib" "inv" "schematic" "" nil "r") then kbd_agent keys ["Return"]. The inv Schematic Editor opens, read-only.
4. observe — confirm a window titled 'Acme EDA Schematic Editor Reading: acme_lib inv schematic'.
5. mouse_agent click inside that editor's canvas, then kbd_agent keys ["f"] — Fit.
6. Repeat steps 2-5 with "nand2" in the openCellView line for the second editor.
7. done — report the two editor titles exactly as observed (max 40 words).
HOW THIS SCREEN WORKS: the viewer is a live picture of a remote computer. Everything inside it — the remote top bar, the command window, the editors — is that remote machine's own desktop, and all of it is directly clickable/typeable: your input lands inside the viewer. There is no other screen and nothing is missing. Remote windows are pixels inside ONE window, so win_agent list never lists them — expected, not a blocker.
description: EXAMPLE runbook pack (fictional names throughout). Tailors a VNC run to an EDA-style application living inside a remote-desktop viewer: the app has a main command window whose bottom line executes a scripting language, and document windows that open read-only from a library/cell pair. Copy this file, replace the fictional library/cell names and window descriptions with your own, and point CU_RUNBOOK_PACK at it.

done_hints.kbd: type_verify the openCellView line from the plan, then keys ["Return"]
done_hints.mouse: click with text "the Acme EDA command line"
